title: Crestline Summit Club Entry Entitlements by Membership
content:
Entry entitlements of the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships, membership by membership. "Yes" means the entitlement is part of the membership; "No" means it is not.

| Entitlement | Summit Club Essential | Summit Club Individual | Summit Club Individual Plus | Summit Club Executive | Summit Club Corporate | Summit Club Lifetime |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Boarding pass for a same-day departing Crestline or partner flight required for entry | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Earliest entry before the scheduled departure of the member's flight | 3 hours | 3 hours | 3 hours | 3 hours | 3 hours | 3 hours |
| Entry during a connection on a same-day itinerary | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Earliest entry before a delayed flight's new departure during a disruption | 6 hours | 6 hours | 6 hours | 6 hours | 6 hours | 6 hours |
| Entry while travelling on Crestline Basic Economy | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Entry on arrival from a Crestline flight | No | No | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| Partner airline lounges when flying the partner | No | No | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| Summit Club Reserve locations | No | No | No | Yes | No | Yes |

## Distinguishing the memberships

- The timing entitlements are uniform across the range: entry from 3 hours before the scheduled departure of the member's flight, and, during a disruption, from 6 hours before the delayed flight's new departure.
- Summit Club Essential is the one membership whose holder may not enter while travelling on Crestline Basic Economy.
- Entry on arrival, partner airline lounges and the premium Summit Club Reserve locations are entitlements of Summit Club Executive and Summit Club Lifetime only.

## Reading the grid (illustration)

| Situation, as recorded | Summit Club Individual Plus | Summit Club Executive |
|---|---|---|
| Member arriving on a Crestline flight | Entry on arrival not included | Entry on arrival included |
| Member flying a partner airline, at that partner's lounge | Partner lounge access not included | Partner lounge access included |
| Member flying Crestline Basic Economy | Entry while on Basic Economy included | Entry while on Basic Economy included |
